tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_largo_catchy_lick_D:
Largo licks the targeted unit with his tongue, pulling it back a short distance, applying a basic dispel, and dealing damage if it's an enemy.

Killing or dispelling an effect from a target grants Largo temporary health regeneration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_largo_amphibian_rha: Largo gets ready to groove. He is disarmed and his ability bar switches to 3 song abilities, each with different effects. Songs are only effective if strummed on the beat.\n\nEvery time he strums successfully, he gains a stack of Groovin'. The very first Bard Monk played a song that summoned a living island and saved the Murkroot exiles from a salt-worn death.
Items can be used while in this mode.
Largo can play two songs per beat by strumming both at the same time.

tokens.npc_dota_hero_largo_bio: The exiled Murkroots of Velu’Mar discovered a living island so ancient it speaks only in song. Raised among the shamanic bards who learned to commune with it, Largo now roams the realms with a troupe of frogling disciples, looking for inspiration for new melodies to bring back and share with his island home.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_largo_hype: With his slick-strumming fingers and sticky-whip tongue, Largo is always ready to grant his team damage, healing, or speed and dispel friends or foes using just the right lick.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_largo_lore: Largo amplifies his allies on the battlefield, inspiring efficient spellcasting and projecting greater harm upon his foes. He's quick to catch friends and enemies alike, controlling the flow of a skirmish with his sticky tongue, and his froglings are always eager to stomp around underfoot. When a battle really gets hopping, Largo's happy to step into the spotlight and play the hits, strumming his set list of classics that grant his team powerful blessings to slide the tone and tempo of a fight firmly into their own favor.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_largo_npedesc1: Strums music to empower allies and can dispel with a lick

qualifications.raw:
* The ability has two main components:
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|1|21px]] {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|largo_croak_of_genius_buff}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Ally}}
*** Stacks multiplicatively with other [[mana loss manipulation]] sources.
*** The buff duration reduction procs from the following ability cast sources ([[Mana#Mana_Loss_Manipulation|after reductions]]):
**** Per {{Symbol|mp cost}} ability mana cost cast instance.
**** Per instance of {{Symbol|mppi}} ability mana cost per interval.
*** Does not consider {{Symbol|hp cost}} ability health cost cast instances.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|2|21px]] {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
*** Considers {{M|clones}}, {{M|illusions}}, and {{M|creep-heroes}} as heroes.
*** The ability effects are applied as follows:
***# Applies the original ability cast's {{M|spell damage}}.
***# Applies {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|largo_croak_of_genius_debuff (x)}} on the affected enemy unit whenever the {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|largo_croak_of_genius_buff}}-affected allied unit deals spell damage to it.
***#* {{Symbol|Spell Damage}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Modifier|Stack}}
***#** The debuff stack indicates the {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}} per second component.
***#*** The damage per second component utilizes the spell damage value before all [[damage manipulation]] sources.
***#*** The damage applied is sourced to the original ability caster.
***#** Additional spell damage instances applied, from all [[damage types]], while the debuff is active increases the damage per second component.
***#*** However, this neither refreshes the debuff duration nor changes the damage intervals.
***#** Spell damage sources from multiple buff sources create independent debuff instances on the damaged unit.
***#* Does not consider the following damage sources:
***#** {{M|HP Removal}} sources.
***#** {{M|Instant attack}} sources.
***#** {{M|No-reflection}} sources.
***# Deals {{Code|{{#var:Croak of Genius type1 value3}} × ΣSplDmg<sub>i</sub> + {{ValueColor||{{#expr:{{Show|T|Largo|v2r}}/100}}|tal|x}} × EnemyMax[[Health|HP]]}} damage in 1-second intervals, 1 second upon debuff application, over {{#var:Croak of Genius type1 value4}} instances.
***#* Both eveling up the ability and learning the {{ValueColor||max health as damage per second|15tal}} {{M|talent|t=t2r}} immediately update the current active instance.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* Has the following targeting functionalities:
** {{Symbol|Target|AreaAlt}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Aura}} [[File:Dota2 Cast Range to AoE Visualization icon-1.png|84px]]
*** Can affect enemy units at max {{Symbol|bonus cas}} {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{#expr:{{#var:Frogstomp cast range}}+{{#var:Frogstomp value1}}}}-distance away with the [[cast range]] and [[effect radius]].
*** {{#var:Frogstomp value2}} seconds after cast, the ability creates a negative [[aura]] at the {{Symbol|Target|AreaAlt}} area-targeted location.
*** The aura has two main components
**** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|1|21px]] {{Symbol|Dot|On}} ... {{Symbol|Dot|On}}
***** The following sources do not update the current instance:
****** Leveling up the ability.
****** {{cf|talnotes}} Learning either the {{ValueColor||damage per instance increasing|10tal}} or the {{ValueColor||interval increasing|25tal}} {{M|talent|t=t4l1r|text=talents}}.
***** The ability effect's {{#var:Frogstomp value4}} ({{Symbol|bonus t4l}} {{ValueColor||{{#var:Frogstomp value4 tal}}|25tal}})-second interval is set upon cast, per cast, and are applied over {{#var:Frogstomp value3}} ({{Symbol|bonus t4l}} {{ValueColor||{{calc|v1+1|v1={{#var:Frogstomp value3 tal}}}}|25tal}}) intervals:
*****# {{Symbol|Stun}} {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|[[stun]]ned}}
*****# The {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}}.
***** {{Symbol|Target|Area-Inter}}
****** Multiple overlapping stun and spell damage component of Frogstomp fully stack.
**** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|2|21px]] {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|largo_frogstomp_debuff}}
***** {{Symbol|Target|Area-Inter}}
****** Multiple overlapping {{M|movement speed}} slow auras of Frogstomp do not stack, with the first applied aura having precedence.
*** Affect the following units:
**** {{M|Fogged}} units.
**** {{M|Invisible}} units.
*** Does not affect the following units:
**** {{M|Hidden}} units.
**** {{M|Invulnerable}} units.
** {{Symbol|Target|Portrait}}
*** Considers [[portrait-casting]] as a {{Symbol|Target|Ground}} ground-targeted cast, and centers the radius around Largo.

fields.name: lore
fields.value: The very first Bard Monk played a song that summoned a living island and saved the Murkroot exiles from a salt-worn death.

fields.name: desc0
fields.value:
Switches the ability bar switches to three song abilities, each with different ability effects.

Largo can cast one Amphibian Rhapsody-based abilities at any given time.

fields.name: desc1
fields.value:
Gains a Groovin' stack per successful strum on beat, which grants bonus armor and reduces the mana cost of the song abilities.

Largo loses a Groovin' stack whenever he misses a beat.

Self-disarms upon casting any song abilities.

fields.name: type1 trait6
fields.value: Song Mana Cost Reduction per Stack

fields.name: desc2
fields.value: Grants allied units within the radius a lesser armor bonus corresponding to the Groovin' stacks.

fields.name: desc3

data.name: npc_dota_hero_largo
data.bio_loc: The exiled Murkroots of Velu’Mar discovered a living island so ancient it speaks only in song. Raised among the shamanic bards who learned to commune with it, Largo now roams the realms with a troupe of frogling disciples, looking for inspiration for new melodies to bring back and share with his island home.
data.hype_loc: With his slick-strumming fingers and sticky-whip tongue, Largo is always ready to grant his team damage, healing, or speed and dispel friends or foes using just the right lick.
data.npe_desc_loc: Strums music to empower allies and can dispel with a lick

abilities.name: largo_catchy_lick
abilities.desc_loc:
Largo licks the targeted unit with his tongue, pulling it back a short distance, applying a basic dispel, and dealing damage if it's an enemy.

Killing or dispelling an effect from a target grants Largo temporary health regeneration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
abilities.lore_loc: After generations spent living on the ancient isaloth Velu'Mar, the descendants of the Murkroot exiles have grown resilient, happily sampling toxins that would've struck their ancestors dead.
notes_loc: Can lick runes to pull them.

abilities.name: largo_frogstomp
abilities.desc_loc: Largo tosses froglings to an area. They stomp the ground every %stomp_interval% second, dealing damage and ministuns, and enemies in the area have reduced movement speed.
abilities.lore_loc: Most Bard Monks spend decades mastering the musical arts, but even the top frog Largo has to admit that his young disciples have already grown shockingly good at counting a proper beat.

abilities.name: largo_croak_of_genius
abilities.desc_loc:
Largo strums a tune to a friendly hero. The hero's items and abilities have reduced mana cost and a percentage of their damage reverberates over the following %damage_duration% seconds.

When an affected hero spends mana, the remaining buff duration is reduced by %duration_reduction%s. Duration is not reduced for Largo himself.
abilities.lore_loc: Largo loves to help his friends find glory through the power of music, never missing a chance at a killer duet.
notes_loc: Only applies to damage sources affected by spell amplification.
Only applies to damage where the source and target are within %max_distance% units of each other.

abilities.name: largo_encore
abilities.desc_loc: Buffs that Largo applies to himself or his team have extended duration.
abilities.shard_loc:
Whenever Largo applies a Unit Target buff to a friendly hero, he also gets the buff.

If Largo targets himself, the buff is also applied to the nearest allied hero within the cast range of the targeted ability.

abilities.name: largo_amphibian_rhapsody
abilities.desc_loc:
Largo gets ready to groove. He is disarmed and his ability bar switches to 3 song abilities, each with different effects. Songs are only effective if strummed on the beat.

Every time he strums successfully, he gains a stack of Groovin'. Each stack gives him bonus armor and reduces the mana cost of every song, but he loses a stack if he misses a beat. Stacks linger for a short duration when Largo's song ends.
abilities.lore_loc: The very first Bard Monk played a song that summoned a living island and saved the Murkroot exiles from a salt-worn death.
notes_loc: Items can be used while in this mode.
abilities.scepter_loc: Largo can play two songs per beat by strumming both at the same time.

special_values.name: song_cost_reduction_per_stack_tooltip
special_values.heading_loc: SONG MANA COST REDUCTION PER STACK:

abilities.name: largo_song_fight_song
abilities.desc_loc: Largo plays a song that deals %burst_damage% magical damage to nearby enemies. The song also increases nearby allied heroes' spell amplification and grants their attacks additional magic damage.
abilities.lore_loc: 'Hey, when a beach brawl breaks out, you gotta learn to throw your musical weight around or the party's over proper quick.'
abilities.scepter_loc: Deals additional %damage_per_stack% magic damage per Groovin' stack when this song is used in double-strumming.

abilities.name: largo_song_double_time
abilities.desc_loc: Largo plays a song that increases nearby friendly units' movement speed and grants a brief slow resistance.
abilities.lore_loc: 'It's like that old story about the scary swamp witch. You better watch just where you're jumping when you're trying to do it lickety-split.'

abilities.name: largo_song_good_vibrations
abilities.desc_loc: Largo plays a song that heals nearby friendly heroes.
abilities.lore_loc: 'If this song can heal an ageless isaloth, it can handle a few cuts and bruises on the lot of you.'
